name: Mangmühlenzeltplatz
beschreibung: The Mangmühlenzeltplatz is located in the Tiroler Inntal, in the municipality of Kramsach. The surroundings are characterized by forests and the nearby Inn. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a kiosk, and simple pitches for tents. The quiet atmosphere makes the site attractive for those seeking relaxation. The target group is primarily hikers and cyclists. The kiosk offers simple food and drinks.
